title: Neutron stars are crucial for understanding extreme physics.
purpose: Summarize their importance to fundamental science.
narration: Neutron stars are cosmic laboratories for extreme physics. Their immense gravity and density allow scientists to test the limits of our understanding. This makes them vital for fundamental science. By studying neutron stars, researchers gain insights into the behavior of matter under conditions impossible to recreate on Earth.
